discovered_repositories.notes: Fresh Next.js scaffold; SkillSync product not yet built. Top-level app/, components/, lib/, hooks/ (no src/). prisma/ and dev.db present. All initiative work (both modules, catalog, the loop, fixtures, prompts in src/prompts/) lands here. Next.js 16 has breaking changes — consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing Next.js code. UPDATE (post-gate, 2026-06-05): new MVP requirements add real Google OAuth (NextAuth/Auth.js-style, hosted-domain restricted to nulogic.io), resume parsing (synthetic fixtures in fixtures/resumes/), a skill state machine (self-reported/manager-approved/verified), and baseline-skill capture — all within this same single app repo. No new repos introduced. New env vars: Google OAuth client ID/secret (read from env, never committed).

summary.rationale: Hackathon MVP is a single self-contained Next.js app on NULogic Git; no cross-repo dependencies.
